response.sql: WITH ev AS (SELECT e.event_id, e.status, AVG(b.remaining) AS ar, AVG((b.spent - b.amount) * 1.0 / b.amount) AS ao FROM budget b JOIN event e ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event GROUP BY e.event_id, e.status), overall AS (SELECT AVG(ar) AS o FROM ev) SELECT status, AVG(ar) AS avg_remaining, AVG(ao) AS avg_overspend_rate, AVG(ar) / (SELECT o FROM overall) AS remaining_ratio_to_overall FROM ev GROUP BY status

assumptions.assumption: The overall average remaining is the average of the event-level average remaining across all matched events, which is the same level as the per-status figures.
Budget lines with amount = 0 give a NULL overspend rate and are ignored in that average. Events with no non-null values are ignored in the status averages.

alternatives.interpretation: The overall average remaining is the plain average of remaining across all matched budget lines, not the average of event averages.
